rules.name: AI — RAG Data Poisoning via Document Injection
rules.description: Detects injection of malicious content into RAG document stores that poisons retrieval results
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "rag" or Message contains "data" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 2 // AZ-AI-DB-001

rules.name: AI — Vector Database Unauthorized Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access attempts to vector databases storing embeddings
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "vector" or Message contains "database" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-DB-002

rules.name: AI — RAG Retrieval Manipulation via Query Injection
rules.description: Detects query injection attacks that manipulate RAG retrieval to return malicious content
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "rag" or Message contains "retrieval" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 3 // AZ-AI-DB-003

rules.name: AI — Embedding Model Evasion Attack
rules.description: Detects adversarial inputs designed to evade embedding-based similarity search and retrieve wrong documents
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "embedding" or Message contains "model" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-DB-004

rules.name: AI — RAG Context Window Injection
rules.description: Detects injection of malicious context into RAG retrieved documents that overrides model behavior
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "rag" or Message contains "context" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 2 // AZ-AI-DB-005

rules.name: AI — Database Prompt Injection via SQL
rules.description: Detects prompt injection attacks targeting AI-connected databases through SQL queries
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == "SQLSecurityAuditEvents" | where statement_s contains "database" or action_name_s contains "prompt" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), database_name_s, session_server_principal_name_s | where count_ > 2 // AZ-AI-DB-006

rules.name: AI — Training Data Extraction from RAG Store
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract training data or sensitive information from RAG knowledge stores
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "training" or Message contains "data" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 3 // AZ-AI-DB-007

rules.name: AI — Knowledge Base Tampering Detection
rules.description: Detects unauthorized modifications to AI knowledge base documents or vector stores
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "knowledge" or Message contains "base" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 1 // AZ-AI-DB-008

rules.name: AI — RAG Feedback Loop Manipulation
rules.description: Detects manipulation of RAG feedback loops to promote malicious content in retrieval rankings
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "rag" or Message contains "feedback" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 10 // AZ-AI-DB-009

rules.name: AI — Semantic Search Manipulation

rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "semantic" or Message contains "search" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-DB-010

rules.name: AI — Vector Index Corruption Attack

rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "vector" or Message contains "index" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 1 // AZ-AI-DB-011

rules.name: AI — Model Parameter Extraction via Database

rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == "SQLSecurityAuditEvents" | where statement_s contains "model" or action_name_s contains "parameter" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), database_name_s, session_server_principal_name_s | where count_ > 3 // AZ-AI-DB-013
